notes.title: Ales Dash - Update 2.8.0 | Adding a 3D Guide and modifying the Camera
notes.content:
Added 3D Guide function
3D guide function added. You can switch it on or off with the option on the title screen or with the cancel key (X for keyboard).

Correct the Camera
We corrected the  View of the camera, making the sense of distance clear.

notes.title: Ales Dash - Update 2.7.8 | Fixed some bugs
notes.content:
Fixed a few bugs.
The changes are as follows.

· Fixed where the timing is extremely difficult at a certain level of challenge mode
· Fixed the condition that falling mistakes do not occur at a specific level in challenge mode
· In the challenge mode level selection screen, the problem that the arrow to move the item is not displayed was fixed

notes.title: Ales Dash - Update 2.7.7 | Fixed bug where high score could not be sent
notes.content:
Fixed a problem of freezing when entering a certain combination of letters when sending high score.
We apologize for any inconvenience.

notes.title: Version 2.7.6 Update
notes.content:
Ales Dash has been updated to 2.7.6.
· Added a setting function to switch resolution, full screen, etc.
· At the time of sending a high score, when you press the back space key, change it so that it does not switch to full screen, and you can send it with the Enter key.
